text: The message-display test terminates the background, verifies listeners are primed, opens a message and checks the delivered message list and tab information. It then waits for the restarted background and checks that listeners are persistent but no longer primed. The source still notes an order-dependent failure from an earlier test. Preserve both the listener-state and delivered-content assertions; moving this test first does not prove that the shared-state cause is fixed. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Check event-page priming and wake-up content as separate states
